about:
2GIG Engineering, LLC operates from Abbot, Maine, where it has designed and assembled tilt sensors in the United States since 2015. The company was established to deliver advanced inclinometers for precise motion detection and leveling in demanding industrial and commercial settings.

The product line includes wired and wireless inclinometers with various output options — analog voltage, 4-20 mA, CANBUS, USB, RS232, and Modbus RTU — along with stainless-steel models, switching relays, display packages, and mounting accessories. 2GIG also offers custom design services to tailor sensor specifications to specific application requirements.

Customers span heavy machinery, construction, and renewable energy sectors, as well as broader industrial and commercial markets. The sensors are built to withstand harsh environments and provide reliable performance for equipment leveling, platform monitoring, and motion detection.

The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, stating that its sensors are crafted in the USA with attention to detail for durability and accuracy. It highlights custom design capability and direct customer support as key differentiators.
